The '''Lesser Lantillian Route''' was a major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] which crossed a number of regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] on the route included [[Nazzri]], [[Uyter/Legends|Uyter]], [[Togoria/Legends|Togoria]], [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros IV]], [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]] and [[Peg Shar I/Legends|Peg Shar I]]. [[Pusat Station]] also lay on this route.
